name: demon_skerrick
speaker: Skerrick
notes: Talking to Skerrick while he is CONTAINED (docs/PLAN_demons.md D5; game/demon_talk.h). T within 8 m of his circle opens it. The engine sets two flags before it opens: demon:present (1 the last contract was refused, 2 it bound him, 3 you could not carry the upkeep, 0 none) and demon:bound (1 while he is bound). {tell} is a line from assets/demons/tells.json for the current margin (circle strength - his power - the contract's weight; a refusal speaks for the refused page). The demon actions: present_contract opens the picker of your contract pages, release lets him out (the binding is weighed again with the contract's weight), dismiss sends him home.

nodes.text: The imp squats on his heels inside the salt and grins up at you. "{tell}"

choices.text: I have a contract for you.

nodes.text: "Paper! Skerrick loves paper." He licks his claws. "Show it, then. Show it."
He reads it upside down and cackles. "{tell}"
"Master is too full already. Master cannot carry Skerrick as well." He pats his belly. Free your mana, or send another home first.
The page flares and is gone. Skerrick hisses through his teeth: "Bound. {contract}. Skerrick reads every word."

choices.text: Stay in the ring for now.

nodes.text: Bound by {contract}, he waits at the edge of the salt. "{tell}"
